What you'll find on our shelves

A neighbourhood supermarket stocked for daily cooking. Come in and see the full range.

Fresh halal meat

Lamb, goat, beef and chicken, cut fresh at our meat counter.

Frozen halal

A wide frozen halal range for quick, easy meals.

Fresh produce

Fruit, vegetables and herbs, from everyday staples to okra, yam, plantain and mango.

Rice and grains

Pantry staples including Golden Sella rice, long grain, jasmine and semolina.

Tea

Loose leaf and boxed tea, from Ceylon and Turkish blends to everyday favourites.

Dry fruits and nuts

Dry fruits and nuts for snacking and cooking.

Olives, pickles and jars

Olives, peppers, gherkins and pickles in a full wall of jars.

Bread and eggs

Fresh bread and eggs for the daily shop.

South-East Asian ingredients

Hard-to-find sauces, spices and staples for authentic cooking.

Snacks, sweets and drinks

Crisps, chocolate, sweets and cold drinks by the till.
